title: css-typed-vars config
description: Options for the css-typed-vars CLI: one target, or an array of targets.

input.description: Glob(s) of the CSS files to scan.

output.description: Output file: .ts, .js/.mjs/.cjs (plus a .d.ts), or .json for W3C design tokens (DTCG).

prefix.description: Prefix every generated key. Can't be combined with group.

naming.description: Naming convention of the generated keys. Defaults to camelCase.

selectors.description: Also scan these selectors' blocks, not just :root and @theme.

themes.description: Theme name -> selector ('[data-theme="dark"]') or @media prelude ('@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)'). Values are emitted as @theme JSDoc tags.

group.description: Nest keys by the first hyphen segment of the name (cssVars.color.primary).

helpers.description: Also emit the CssVarRef type and the getCssVar/setCssVar/withFallback helpers.

prune.description: Drop vars with no detected cssVars.<key> usage. Requires usage.

usage.description: Glob(s) of the source files to scan for cssVars usage (prune, --prune-check).

usageExclude.description: Glob(s) of source files to skip in the usage scan.

refsIgnore.description: Names (or --prefix-* patterns) that --lint-refs shouldn't report, e.g. vars set from JS.
